runs.text: By signing below you accept this proposal and authorize the work described in the scope pages.

This proposal is valid for 30 days from the date issued. Work will be scheduled after the signed agreement and deposit are received. Any changes to the scope of work require a written change order. Manufacturer warranties apply to materials; workmanship is warranted per the agreement terms. Payment is due per the payment schedule on the signature page.
